description: This file defines a custom exception class `IdentityProviderException` in the League OAuth2 Client library, specifically under the Provider Exception namespace. It extends the base PHP Exception class and adds functionality to store and retrieve the response body from an identity provider error response.

classes.name: IdentityProviderException
classes.description: Custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, with additional property to hold the provider's response body.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, code, and stores the response body.

methods.name: getResponseBody
methods.description: Method to retrieve the stored response body associated with the exception.
